summary: Iteration 2: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of GEIFEM admin panel and Header bug fix. Fixed 1 backend bug (500 on POST /api/admin/articles due to MongoDB _id leaking into response). Total 47/47 pytest tests pass (30 new admin tests + 17 regression). All 13 requested UI/API flows verified working, including the Header 'Servicios'/'Industrias' clickable-link bug fix, admin login/logout, dashboard stats, leads list, article create+list, and hover dropdowns.

minor.issue: Emergent Email proxy still returns 401 with placeholder EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY. Endpoints degrade gracefully (persist + return success). Same as iteration_1 — expected.

issues: Dropdown works via CSS group-hover only; on mobile (touch) hover is not triggerable — mobile menu has its own accordion so this is OK, but on tablet/touch-hybrid devices the desktop dropdown may not open. Consider adding onClick toggle.

action_items: Replace placeholder EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY with platform-provisioned key so transactional emails deliver (persisted from iteration_1).

OPTIONAL: Sidebar nav testids in AdminLayout are `nav-dashboard/nav-leads/nav-articles/nav-newsletter` while the review request listed `admin-leads/admin-articles/admin-newsletter` — those latter testids exist but are on the PAGE wrappers, not the nav links. Consider aligning naming in a future doc update. Not a bug.
OPTIONAL: On touch devices, hover-only header dropdowns for Servicios/Industrias won't open — top-level link still navigates so it degrades gracefully.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED THIS ITERATION: server.py admin_create_article returned the mongo doc AFTER insert_one, but pymongo's insert_one mutates the doc in-place by adding a non-JSON-serializable ObjectId as `_id`. This caused POST /api/admin/articles to always 500 with `ValueError: [TypeError('ObjectId is not iterable'), TypeError('vars() must have __dict__')]`. Fix: pop('_id', None) before returning. (line 850 in server.py)
server.py is now ~900 lines (up from ~630). Splitting into routers/services modules is even more overdue.
Admin session tokens are stored as plaintext in Mongo and generated by concatenating 2 UUIDs — consider hashing tokens at rest and using `secrets.token_urlsafe(48)` instead.
No rate limit on POST /api/admin/login → allows unlimited password brute-force. Add rate-limiting middleware or lockout after N failed attempts.
admin_delete_contact / admin_delete_subscriber / admin_delete_article are hard deletes with no audit log. For a business admin panel, soft-delete + audit trail is safer.
Public GET /api/articles has no pagination cursor (only `limit`). If article count grows past 50, older articles become inaccessible.
Frontend AdminLayout.jsx uses `localStorage.admin_token` (readable by any XSS) — for tighter security consider HttpOnly cookie session flow.
Article Pydantic model uses `date: datetime = default_factory ...` but there's no field to override `date` on create/update — publishing date is always creation date, no way to backdate.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed and clean up TEST_-prefixed contacts, newsletter subs, and articles inside their own class scope. Some TEST_-prefixed contacts may remain in Mongo from earlier iterations; safe to purge by prefix. Frontend E2E created one TEST_UI article; deleted via API in teardown.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug: POST /api/admin/articles returned 500. Reproduction: send valid ArticleCreate payload with valid admin token. Root cause: `db.articles.insert_one(doc)` mutates `doc` by injecting Mongo's `_id: ObjectId(...)`. Endpoint then returned `{'article': doc, ...}` which FastAPI serialized via jsonable_encoder → failed on ObjectId (not JSON-serializable). Mitigation: `doc.pop('_id', None)` after insert_one, before returning. Applied in server.py line 850. All 9 previously failing article tests now pass.
